name: SDN Peers Discovery Flow
description: HTTP network-discovery flow (gateway loop G.2): a $HTQ HttpRequest enters on the http-request trigger, foundation/http-route discover emits the routing decision (peers_list | peer_get | not_found), hostcap/p2p-discovery peers issues the policy-mediated p2p.peers_snapshot hostcall (the host's peerstore/DHT/registry view + stored $EPM profiles; short-circuited on not_found) and re-emits the decision, foundation/discovery-shape peers splices stored $EPM frames verbatim / synthesizes minimal unsigned EPMs / encodes the bare-array json presentation and the shared FNV-1a etag, and foundation/http-respond assembles the final $HTR envelope (200/304/404) delivered to the host-model egress sink. Bridge linkage: the only host crossing is the declared p2p_read hostcall.

triggers.description: One $HTQ HttpRequest envelope per invocation, pumped by the host at the flow ingress.

api.tagDescription: Peer and standards discovery served by the G.2 gateway flows (wasm; routing, format selection and ETag logic run inside the module; snapshots come from the policy-mediated p2p_read capability).

routes.summary: Known peers with EPM profiles and published standards
routes.description: The host's network view — connected peers, peerstore/DHT entries, registry profiles, and PNM publishers — as one record per peer. Default encoding: aligned size-prefixed $EPM frames (stored profiles verbatim and signature-verifiable; peers without a stored profile get a synthesized minimal unsigned EPM whose DN is the peer id and whose MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS carries /p2p/<peerId>). format=json: bare array of {peer_id, self, connected, agent_version, addrs, standards, epm|null} — standards are derived from stored signed PNMs per publishing peer; epm renders the EPM schema fields with SCHEMA-EXACT names {DN, LEGAL_NAME, ALTERNATE_NAMES, MULTIFORMAT_ADDRESS, ENTITY_TYPE} plus the synthesized lowercase signed (hard rule json-schema-capitalization-rule: SDS-record properties keep the IDL capitalization; API-synthesized fields stay lowercase snake_case).

params.name: format
params.description: Response encoding: flatbuffer = aligned size-prefixed $EPM FlatBuffer stream (default), json = bare JSON array of peer records.

200.description: Peer record stream. Metadata rides in headers on BOTH encodings: X-SDN-Record-Count and a content-derived ETag.

application/vnd.sdn.flatbuffers.stream.description: Aligned size-prefixed $EPM FlatBuffer frames, one per known peer.

application/json.description: Bare top-level JSON array of peer records (format=json).

304.description: Not modified (If-None-Match matched the stream ETag). Empty body, ETag header repeated.

404.description: No route matched under the mount.

routes.summary: One peer's EPM profile and published standards
routes.description: The same record shape as the peers list, narrowed to one libp2p peer id. Unknown peers answer 404.

params.name: peerId
params.description: libp2p peer ID of the provider node (e.g. 16Uiu2HAm…).

params.name: format
params.description: Response encoding, as for the peers list.

200.description: Single-peer record stream (one $EPM frame / one-element bare array); X-SDN-Record-Count and ETag headers on both encodings.

304.description: Not modified (If-None-Match matched the stream ETag).
